name: Camera Shutter Dump
summary: Stack twelve photos into a collage on black, one per camera shutter sound, as editable Image clips with bundled shutter effects.

compatibility.selects: Needs the editor's existing original Image placement service (same as Four Photo Reveal), public clip effects and Audio overlays, and Node.js in the panel shell. Verified in Selects Staging and a local develop build on 2026-09-30: saved Draft readback and HD export.
